(NOAAGlobalTemp), Version 4.0 (Version Superseded)</atom:title><atom:published>2025-09-09T17:01:40.122Z</atom:published><atom:updated>2026-11-05T15:07:16.027Z</atom:updated><atom:summary type="text">*This version has been superseded by a newer version. It is highly recommended for users to access the current version. Users should only access this superseded version for special cases, such as reproducing studies. If necessary, this version can be accessed by contacting NCEI.* The NOAA Global Surface Temperature Dataset (NOAAGlobalTemp) is derived from two independent analyses: the Extended Reconstructed Sea Surface Temperature (ERSST) analysis and the land surface temperature (LST) analysis using the Global Historical Climatology Network (GHCN) temperature database. The data is merged into a monthly global surface temperature dataset dating back from 1880 to the present, updated monthly, in gridded (5 degree x 5 degree) and time series formats. This data set is used in climate monitoring assessments of near-surface temperatures on a global scale. The changes from version 3.5.4 to version 4.0.0 include an update to the primary input dataset (ERSST) now at version 4.0.0 and GHCN-Monthly now at version 3.3.0. This dataset is formerly known as Merged Land-Ocean Surface Temperature (MLOST).</atom:summary><atom:author><atom:name>NCEI</atom:name></atom:author><atom:link rel="alternate" type="application/json" href="http://www.ncei.noaa.gov/metadata/geoportal/rest/metadata/item/gov.noaa.ncdc%3AC00934"/><atom:link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="http://www.ncei.noaa.gov/metadata/geoportal/rest/metadata/item/gov.noaa.ncdc%3AC00934/html"/><atom:link rel="alternate" type="application/xml" href="http://www.ncei.noaa.gov/metadata/geoportal/rest/metadata/item/gov.noaa.ncdc%3AC00934/xml"/><atom:link rel="icon" href="https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/metadata/images/C00934_NOAAGlobalTempusingERSSTv4GHCNMv330_1995to2014.png"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Earth Science > Oceans > Ocean Temperature > Sea Surface Temperature > >"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Earth Science > Land Surface > Land Temperature > >  >"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Earth Science > Climate Indicators > Atmospheric/Ocean Indicators > Temperature Indicators > >"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Oceanic - Surface - Sea-surface Temperature"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Atmospheric - Surface - Air Temperature"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Continent > >  >  >"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Ocean > >  >  >"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Vertical Location > Land Surface"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="Vertical Location > Sea Surface"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="DOC/NOAA/NESDIS/NCDC > National Climatic Data Center, NESDIS, NOAA, U.S. Department of Commerce"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="DOC/NOAA/NESDIS/NCEI > National Centers for Environmental Information, NESDIS, NOAA, U.S. Department of Commerce"/><atom:category scheme="keywords" term="climatologyMeteorologyAtmosphere"/><georss:box>-90 -180 90 180</georss:box><georss10:box>-90 -180 90 180</georss10:box></atom:entry></atom:feed>
